readme: Edit this file, then run python3 scripts/build-bases.py from the site folder. Leave officialSite and housingUrl off unless you have the real official page. servedDirectly should stay true only for installations S2 Home Partners handles itself.

bases.name: Naval Air Station Jacksonville
bases.mission: NAS Jacksonville is a Navy air station on the west side of Jacksonville and a major aviation hub for the Southeast.

bases.name: Naval Station Mayport
bases.mission: Naval Station Mayport is the Navy's third-largest fleet concentration area and sits at the mouth of the St. Johns River.

bases.name: Naval Submarine Base Kings Bay
bases.mission: NSB Kings Bay is the Atlantic home port for the Navy's Ohio-class ballistic-missile submarines.

bases.name: Marine Corps Support Facility Blount Island
bases.mission: Blount Island is the Marine Corps prepositioning base on the St. Johns River in Jacksonville.

bases.name: Camp Blanding Joint Training Center
bases.mission: Camp Blanding is the Florida National Guard's primary training center, between Jacksonville and Gainesville.

bases.name: Coast Guard Sector Jacksonville
bases.mission: Coast Guard Sector Jacksonville directs Coast Guard missions along the northeast Florida coast.

bases.name: Fort Bragg
bases.mission: Fort Bragg is home of the XVIII Airborne Corps, the 82nd Airborne Division, and U.S. Army Special Operations Command.

bases.name: Fort Campbell
bases.mission: Fort Campbell straddles the Kentucky-Tennessee line and is home of the 101st Airborne Division.

bases.name: Fort Hood
bases.mission: Fort Hood is home of III Armored Corps and a major armor and aviation post in Central Texas.

bases.name: Fort Bliss
bases.mission: Fort Bliss is a large Army post in El Paso and home of the 1st Armored Division.

bases.name: Fort Carson
bases.mission: Fort Carson, south of Colorado Springs, is home of the 4th Infantry Division.

bases.name: Fort Stewart
bases.mission: Fort Stewart is home of the 3rd Infantry Division. Hunter Army Airfield in Savannah is part of the same garrison.

bases.name: Hunter Army Airfield
bases.mission: Hunter Army Airfield is the Savannah airfield of the Fort Stewart-Hunter Army Airfield garrison.

bases.name: Fort Benning
bases.mission: Fort Benning is home of the Maneuver Center of Excellence, where the Army trains infantry and armor soldiers.

bases.name: Fort Gordon
bases.mission: Fort Gordon, near Augusta, is the Army's cyber center and home of the Cyber Center of Excellence.

bases.name: Fort Riley
bases.mission: Fort Riley is home of the 1st Infantry Division in the Flint Hills of Kansas.

bases.name: Fort Sill
bases.mission: Fort Sill is the Army's fires center, training field artillery in Lawton, Oklahoma.

bases.name: Fort Drum
bases.mission: Fort Drum is home of the 10th Mountain Division in New York's North Country.

bases.name: Fort Wainwright
bases.mission: Fort Wainwright is the Army's interior Alaska post, next to Fairbanks.

bases.name: Fort Greely
bases.mission: Fort Greely, near Delta Junction, hosts the Army's ground-based missile defense site.

bases.name: Fort Irwin
bases.mission: Fort Irwin is the National Training Center in the Mojave Desert.

bases.name: Fort Huachuca
bases.mission: Fort Huachuca is the Army's intelligence center in southeast Arizona.

bases.name: Fort Leonard Wood
bases.mission: Fort Leonard Wood trains Army engineers, military police, and chemical soldiers.

bases.name: Fort Jackson
bases.mission: Fort Jackson in Columbia is the Army's largest basic combat training post.

bases.name: Fort Knox
bases.mission: Fort Knox is home of the Army's Human Resources Command and the U.S. Army Cadet Command.

bases.name: Fort Leavenworth
bases.mission: Fort Leavenworth is home of the Army's Command and General Staff College.

bases.name: Fort Belvoir
bases.mission: Fort Belvoir is a headquarters post in Fairfax County, south of Washington, D.C.

bases.name: Fort George G. Meade
bases.mission: Fort Meade is home of U.S. Cyber Command and the National Security Agency.

bases.name: Fort Detrick
bases.mission: Fort Detrick in Frederick is a center for Army medical research.

bases.name: Fort Hamilton
bases.mission: Fort Hamilton is the Army's last active post in New York City, at the Brooklyn end of the Verrazzano Bridge.

bases.name: Fort Lee
bases.mission: Fort Lee is home of the Army's Sustainment Center of Excellence, south of Richmond.

bases.name: Fort Polk
bases.mission: Fort Polk is home of the Joint Readiness Training Center in west-central Louisiana.

bases.name: Fort Rucker
bases.mission: Fort Rucker is the Army's aviation center, where helicopter pilots train.

bases.name: Aberdeen Proving Ground
bases.mission: Aberdeen Proving Ground is an Army research and test installation on the Chesapeake Bay.

bases.name: Carlisle Barracks
bases.mission: Carlisle Barracks is home of the U.S. Army War College.

bases.name: Fort Anderson-Pinn-Hill
bases.mission: Fort A.P. Hill is an Army training installation in Caroline County, Virginia.

bases.name: Fort Pickett
bases.mission: Fort Pickett is a Virginia National Guard maneuver training center south of Farmville.

bases.name: Redstone Arsenal
bases.mission: Redstone Arsenal in Huntsville is the Army's center for missile and aviation program offices.

bases.name: Rock Island Arsenal
bases.mission: Rock Island Arsenal is an Army manufacturing arsenal on an island in the Mississippi River.

bases.name: Picatinny Arsenal
bases.mission: Picatinny Arsenal is the Army's armaments research center in northern New Jersey.

bases.name: Watervliet Arsenal
bases.mission: Watervliet Arsenal, on the Hudson River, is the Army's cannon foundry.

bases.name: Dugway Proving Ground
bases.mission: Dugway Proving Ground is a remote Army test range in Utah's west desert.

bases.name: White Sands Missile Range
bases.mission: White Sands Missile Range is the Army's large missile test range in southern New Mexico.

bases.name: Yuma Proving Ground
bases.mission: Yuma Proving Ground is an Army desert test range northeast of Yuma.

bases.name: Presidio of Monterey
bases.mission: The Presidio of Monterey is home of the Defense Language Institute.

bases.name: United States Military Academy
bases.mission: West Point is the U.S. Military Academy on the Hudson River.

bases.name: Schofield Barracks
bases.mission: Schofield Barracks is the Army's main post in central Oahu and home of the 25th Infantry Division.

bases.name: Fort Shafter
bases.mission: Fort Shafter in Honolulu is headquarters of U.S. Army Pacific.

bases.name: Fort McCoy
bases.mission: Fort McCoy is a Total Army training and mobilization post in west-central Wisconsin.

bases.name: Camp Shelby
bases.mission: Camp Shelby is a large National Guard training site south of Hattiesburg.

bases.name: Camp Atterbury
bases.mission: Camp Atterbury is the Indiana National Guard's major training installation south of Indianapolis.

bases.name: Camp Ripley
bases.mission: Camp Ripley is the Minnesota National Guard training center on the Mississippi River.

bases.name: Fort Indiantown Gap
bases.mission: Fort Indiantown Gap is the Pennsylvania National Guard's training center east of Harrisburg.

bases.name: Camp Roberts
bases.mission: Camp Roberts is a California Army National Guard training site in the Salinas Valley.

bases.name: Naval Station Norfolk
bases.mission: Naval Station Norfolk is the Navy's largest naval station and a major East Coast fleet home port.

bases.name: Naval Air Station Oceana
bases.mission: NAS Oceana is the Navy's East Coast master jet base in Virginia Beach.

bases.name: Joint Expeditionary Base Little Creek-Fort Story
bases.mission: JEB Little Creek-Fort Story is the East Coast home of Navy expeditionary and special warfare forces.

bases.name: Naval Station Newport
bases.mission: Naval Station Newport is home of the Naval War College and several Navy schools.

bases.name: Naval Air Station Pensacola
bases.mission: NAS Pensacola is the Navy's home of naval aviation training and the National Naval Aviation Museum.

bases.name: Naval Air Station Whiting Field
bases.mission: NAS Whiting Field in Milton is a primary Navy and Marine Corps flight training base.

bases.name: Naval Submarine Base New London
bases.mission: Naval Submarine Base New London is the Navy's first submarine base and home of the Submarine School.

bases.name: Naval Air Station Patuxent River
bases.mission: NAS Patuxent River is the Navy's principal aircraft test center.

bases.name: United States Naval Academy
bases.mission: The U.S. Naval Academy trains Navy and Marine Corps officers on the Severn River in Annapolis.

bases.name: Naval Station Great Lakes
bases.mission: Naval Station Great Lakes is the Navy's only boot camp.

bases.name: Naval Air Station Corpus Christi
bases.mission: NAS Corpus Christi is a Navy pilot training base on the Texas Gulf Coast.

bases.name: Naval Air Station Kingsville
bases.mission: NAS Kingsville is a Navy jet training base southwest of Corpus Christi.

bases.name: Naval Air Station Joint Reserve Base Fort Worth
bases.mission: NAS JRB Fort Worth is a joint reserve air base on the west side of Fort Worth.

bases.name: Naval Air Station Joint Reserve Base New Orleans
bases.mission: NAS JRB New Orleans is a joint reserve base in Belle Chasse, across the river from New Orleans.

bases.name: Naval Base San Diego
bases.mission: Naval Base San Diego is the Navy's principal Pacific surface-ship home port.

bases.name: Naval Base Coronado
bases.mission: Naval Base Coronado includes NAS North Island and the amphibious base on the Silver Strand.

bases.name: Naval Base Point Loma
bases.mission: Naval Base Point Loma is a submarine and mine-warfare installation on the Point Loma peninsula.

bases.name: Naval Air Station Lemoore
bases.mission: NAS Lemoore is the Navy's West Coast master jet base in California's San Joaquin Valley.

bases.name: Naval Air Station Fallon
bases.mission: NAS Fallon is home of the Naval Aviation Warfighting Development Center, including TOPGUN.

bases.name: Naval Air Station Whidbey Island
bases.mission: NAS Whidbey Island is a Navy patrol and electronic-attack aviation base on Whidbey Island.

bases.name: Naval Station Everett
bases.mission: Naval Station Everett is a Navy home port on Port Gardner Bay, north of Seattle.

bases.name: Naval Base Kitsap
bases.mission: Naval Base Kitsap includes the Bremerton shipyard and the Bangor submarine base on Puget Sound.

bases.name: Naval Air Station Meridian
bases.mission: NAS Meridian is a Navy jet training base east of Meridian.

bases.name: Naval Support Activity Mid-South
bases.mission: NSA Mid-South in Millington is a Navy personnel and personnel-support hub north of Memphis.

bases.name: Naval Air Station Key West
bases.mission: NAS Key West is a Navy air station used for tactical aviation training at the end of the Florida Keys.

bases.name: Naval Base Guam
bases.mission: Naval Base Guam is the Navy's main installation on Guam, at Apra Harbor.

bases.name: Portsmouth Naval Shipyard
bases.mission: Portsmouth Naval Shipyard maintains Navy submarines on the Piscataqua River between Maine and New Hampshire.

bases.name: Norfolk Naval Shipyard
bases.mission: Norfolk Naval Shipyard is the Navy's oldest shipyard, in Portsmouth, Virginia.

bases.name: Naval Support Activity Bethesda
bases.mission: NSA Bethesda is the installation that hosts Walter Reed National Military Medical Center.

bases.name: Washington Navy Yard
bases.mission: The Washington Navy Yard is the Navy's headquarters installation in Southeast Washington, D.C.

bases.name: Naval Support Activity Panama City
bases.mission: NSA Panama City is a Navy research installation on St. Andrew Bay.

bases.name: Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune
bases.mission: Camp Lejeune is the Marine Corps' principal East Coast operating base, home of II Marine Expeditionary Force.

bases.name: Marine Corps Air Station New River
bases.mission: MCAS New River, beside Camp Lejeune, is the Marine Corps' East Coast tiltrotor and helicopter air station.

bases.name: Marine Corps Air Station Cherry Point
bases.mission: MCAS Cherry Point is a Marine Corps air station and depot on the Neuse River.

bases.name: Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton
bases.mission: Camp Pendleton is the Marine Corps' main West Coast base, between Oceanside and San Clemente.

bases.name: Marine Corps Air Station Miramar
bases.mission: MCAS Miramar is a Marine Corps jet base in northern San Diego.

bases.name: Marine Corps Recruit Depot San Diego
bases.mission: MCRD San Diego is the Marine Corps recruit depot for recruits from west of the Mississippi.

bases.name: Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center Twentynine Palms
bases.mission: Twentynine Palms is the Marine Corps' large desert training base in the Mojave.

bases.name: Marine Corps Air Station Yuma
bases.mission: MCAS Yuma is a Marine Corps aviation and weapons training station in southwest Arizona.

bases.name: Marine Corps Base Quantico
bases.mission: Quantico is home of Marine Corps Officer Candidates School, the FBI Academy, and the Marine Corps University.

bases.name: Marine Corps Base Hawaii
bases.mission: Marine Corps Base Hawaii is at Kaneohe Bay on the windward side of Oahu.

bases.name: Marine Corps Recruit Depot Parris Island
bases.mission: Parris Island is the Marine Corps recruit depot for recruits from east of the Mississippi.

bases.name: Marine Corps Air Station Beaufort
bases.mission: MCAS Beaufort is a Marine Corps fighter base near Beaufort, South Carolina.

bases.name: Marine Corps Logistics Base Albany
bases.mission: MCLB Albany is a Marine Corps logistics base in southwest Georgia.

bases.name: Marine Corps Logistics Base Barstow
bases.mission: MCLB Barstow is a Marine Corps logistics base in the Mojave Desert.

bases.name: Joint Base Lewis-McChord
bases.mission: Joint Base Lewis-McChord combines the former Fort Lewis and McChord Air Force Base south of Tacoma.

bases.name: Joint Base San Antonio
bases.mission: Joint Base San Antonio includes Fort Sam Houston, Lackland, and Randolph and is the military's largest medical training center.

bases.name: Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam
bases.mission: Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam is the Navy and Air Force joint base at Pearl Harbor.

bases.name: Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson
bases.mission: Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson combines Elmendorf Air Force Base and Fort Richardson in Anchorage.

bases.name: Joint Base Langley-Eustis
bases.mission: Joint Base Langley-Eustis combines Langley Air Force Base in Hampton and Fort Eustis in Newport News.

bases.name: Joint Base Andrews
bases.mission: Joint Base Andrews, in suburban Maryland, is the home base of Air Force One.

bases.name: Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst
bases.mission: Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst combines McGuire Air Force Base, Fort Dix, and Naval Air Engineering Station Lakehurst.

bases.name: Joint Base Charleston
bases.mission: Joint Base Charleston includes Charleston Air Force Base and Naval Weapons Station Charleston.

bases.name: Joint Base Anacostia-Bolling
bases.mission: Joint Base Anacostia-Bolling is a Navy and Air Force joint base along the Anacostia and Potomac rivers.

bases.name: Joint Base Myer-Henderson Hall
bases.mission: Joint Base Myer-Henderson Hall includes Fort Myer and Henderson Hall next to Arlington National Cemetery.

bases.name: Eglin Air Force Base
bases.mission: Eglin Air Force Base is a large Air Force test and fighter installation on the Florida Panhandle.

bases.name: Hurlburt Field
bases.mission: Hurlburt Field is the Air Force installation next to Eglin that hosts Air Force Special Operations Command.

bases.name: Tyndall Air Force Base
bases.mission: Tyndall Air Force Base sits on a peninsula east of Panama City and trains F-22 and F-35 pilots.

bases.name: MacDill Air Force Base
bases.mission: MacDill Air Force Base is on the Interbay Peninsula in South Tampa and hosts U.S. Central Command headquarters.

bases.name: Nellis Air Force Base
bases.mission: Nellis Air Force Base, northeast of Las Vegas, is home of the Air Force Warfare Center.

bases.name: Creech Air Force Base
bases.mission: Creech Air Force Base, northwest of Las Vegas, is a remotely piloted aircraft installation.

bases.name: Luke Air Force Base
bases.mission: Luke Air Force Base, west of Phoenix, is an F-35 training base.

bases.name: Davis-Monthan Air Force Base
bases.mission: Davis-Monthan Air Force Base is in Tucson and hosts the Air Force's aircraft storage and regeneration facility.

bases.name: Travis Air Force Base
bases.mission: Travis Air Force Base is an Air Mobility Command base between San Francisco and Sacramento.

bases.name: Beale Air Force Base
bases.mission: Beale Air Force Base, north of Sacramento, flies reconnaissance aircraft including the U-2.

bases.name: Edwards Air Force Base
bases.mission: Edwards Air Force Base is the Air Force flight test center in the Mojave Desert.

bases.name: United States Air Force Academy
bases.mission: The U.S. Air Force Academy trains Air Force and Space Force officers north of Colorado Springs.

bases.name: F. E. Warren Air Force Base
bases.mission: F. E. Warren Air Force Base in Cheyenne is a Minuteman III missile wing.

bases.name: Malmstrom Air Force Base
bases.mission: Malmstrom Air Force Base in Great Falls is a Minuteman III missile wing.

bases.name: Minot Air Force Base
bases.mission: Minot Air Force Base hosts both a B-52 bomb wing and a Minuteman III missile wing.

bases.name: Grand Forks Air Force Base
bases.mission: Grand Forks Air Force Base flies remotely piloted aircraft and refueling missions in the Red River Valley.

bases.name: Ellsworth Air Force Base
bases.mission: Ellsworth Air Force Base, east of Rapid City, is a B-1 bomber base.

bases.name: Offutt Air Force Base
bases.mission: Offutt Air Force Base in Bellevue is headquarters of U.S. Strategic Command.

bases.name: Whiteman Air Force Base
bases.mission: Whiteman Air Force Base is the home of the B-2 bomber wing.

bases.name: Scott Air Force Base
bases.mission: Scott Air Force Base, east of St. Louis, is headquarters of U.S. Transportation Command.

bases.name: Wright-Patterson Air Force Base
bases.mission: Wright-Patterson Air Force Base is the Air Force's large research and acquisition center in Dayton.

bases.name: Tinker Air Force Base
bases.mission: Tinker Air Force Base is a major Air Force depot and sustainment center in Oklahoma City.

bases.name: Altus Air Force Base
bases.mission: Altus Air Force Base trains airlift and tanker aircrews in southwest Oklahoma.

bases.name: Vance Air Force Base
bases.mission: Vance Air Force Base is a joint pilot training base in Enid.

bases.name: Sheppard Air Force Base
bases.mission: Sheppard Air Force Base is a major technical and pilot training base in Wichita Falls.

bases.name: Dyess Air Force Base
bases.mission: Dyess Air Force Base in Abilene flies B-1 bombers and C-130 airlift aircraft.

bases.name: Laughlin Air Force Base
bases.mission: Laughlin Air Force Base is a pilot training base on the Rio Grande at Del Rio.

bases.name: Goodfellow Air Force Base
bases.mission: Goodfellow Air Force Base in San Angelo trains intelligence and firefighting specialists.

bases.name: Barksdale Air Force Base
bases.mission: Barksdale Air Force Base is a B-52 bomber base across the river from Shreveport.

bases.name: Columbus Air Force Base
bases.mission: Columbus Air Force Base is an Air Force pilot training base in northeast Mississippi.

bases.name: Keesler Air Force Base
bases.mission: Keesler Air Force Base in Biloxi is a large Air Force technical training center.

bases.name: Maxwell Air Force Base
bases.mission: Maxwell Air Force Base in Montgomery is home of Air University.

bases.name: Robins Air Force Base
bases.mission: Robins Air Force Base is an Air Force sustainment center south of Macon.

bases.name: Moody Air Force Base
bases.mission: Moody Air Force Base flies search-and-rescue and attack aircraft near Valdosta.

bases.name: Shaw Air Force Base
bases.mission: Shaw Air Force Base near Sumter is headquarters of U.S. Air Forces Central and Ninth Air Force.

bases.name: Seymour Johnson Air Force Base
bases.mission: Seymour Johnson Air Force Base in Goldsboro flies F-15E Strike Eagles and KC-46 tankers.

bases.name: Dover Air Force Base
bases.mission: Dover Air Force Base is an airlift base and the home of the Air Force mortuary.

bases.name: Hill Air Force Base
bases.mission: Hill Air Force Base is an Air Force depot and F-35 sustainment center north of Salt Lake City.

bases.name: Mountain Home Air Force Base
bases.mission: Mountain Home Air Force Base flies fighter aircraft in southwest Idaho.

bases.name: Fairchild Air Force Base
bases.mission: Fairchild Air Force Base, west of Spokane, is an air refueling wing.

bases.name: McConnell Air Force Base
bases.mission: McConnell Air Force Base is an air refueling wing on the southeast side of Wichita.

bases.name: Little Rock Air Force Base
bases.mission: Little Rock Air Force Base is the Air Force's C-130 training base, northeast of Little Rock.

bases.name: Cannon Air Force Base
bases.mission: Cannon Air Force Base near Clovis is an Air Force special operations wing.

bases.name: Holloman Air Force Base
bases.mission: Holloman Air Force Base, west of Alamogordo, trains F-16 pilots and flies MQ-9 aircraft.

bases.name: Kirtland Air Force Base
bases.mission: Kirtland Air Force Base shares runways with Albuquerque's airport and hosts nuclear and special operations units.

bases.name: Eielson Air Force Base
bases.mission: Eielson Air Force Base, southeast of Fairbanks, flies F-35 fighters.

bases.name: Andersen Air Force Base
bases.mission: Andersen Air Force Base is the Air Force's main bomber and airlift base on Guam.

bases.name: Peterson Space Force Base
bases.mission: Peterson Space Force Base in Colorado Springs is a headquarters installation for U.S. Space Force and NORAD-related commands.

bases.name: Schriever Space Force Base
bases.mission: Schriever Space Force Base, east of Colorado Springs, operates military satellite control.

bases.name: Buckley Space Force Base
bases.mission: Buckley Space Force Base is on the east side of Aurora, in the Denver metro area.

bases.name: Vandenberg Space Force Base
bases.mission: Vandenberg Space Force Base on the California coast launches satellites into polar orbit.

bases.name: Patrick Space Force Base
bases.mission: Patrick Space Force Base supports launches from the adjacent Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.

bases.name: Los Angeles Air Force Base
bases.mission: Los Angeles Air Force Base in El Segundo is the Space Systems Command acquisition installation.

bases.name: Coast Guard Base Portsmouth
bases.mission: Coast Guard Base Portsmouth is a major Atlantic Coast Guard base in the Hampton Roads shipyard district.

bases.name: Coast Guard Base Elizabeth City
bases.mission: Coast Guard Base Elizabeth City is the Coast Guard's aviation technical and air-station hub in northeast North Carolina.

bases.name: Coast Guard Training Center Cape May
bases.mission: Training Center Cape May is the Coast Guard's only enlisted recruit training center.

bases.name: Coast Guard Base Alameda
bases.mission: Coast Guard Base Alameda is the Pacific area logistics and cutter base in San Francisco Bay.

bases.name: Coast Guard Base Kodiak
bases.mission: Coast Guard Base Kodiak is the largest Coast Guard base and the main air station for Alaska.

bases.name: Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater
bases.mission: Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater is the Coast Guard's largest air station and flies missions over the Gulf and Caribbean.

bases.name: Coast Guard Base Miami Beach
bases.mission: Coast Guard Base Miami Beach supports cutters and Sector Miami at the Port of Miami.

bases.name: United States Coast Guard Academy
bases.mission: The U.S. Coast Guard Academy trains Coast Guard officers on the Thames River in New London.

bases.name: Coast Guard Sector San Juan
bases.mission: Coast Guard Sector San Juan directs Coast Guard missions throughout Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands.
